result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-around payment processor**\. However, the best choice depends on what platform your store uses, how much you sell, and whether you also sell in person.

Here's how I'd rank the top options for a small U.S.-based business in 2026.

## Best payment processors compared

![CPGIO - Multichannel eCommerce Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/PjgYNLsLO5kyHaLbRGf_vEGDklf86yBgljtBg18t7Dvw-WgJwtAR87t17RVnZQNRleNsnU2jfdTsx-hJkwGMn58MvL69dhGg6Mz4413HP_F8ItDmZVpm38tgVXpxLOBbHgVAgnhtZKjtJgc5PKyPg4Dx8NXHfNqw_93O-hccPsS0BrwP9sqrs9aaI_I6CV7n?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Standard online card rate: 2.9% + \$0.30
- No monthly processing fee
- Excellent integrations and reporting
- Supports subscriptions, Apple Pay, Google Pay and international payments

Best for: Independent online stores, WooCommerce, and custom websites.

[Stripe website](https://stripe.com)

---

![PayPal | 2024 Campus Forward Award Winner](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1CZkwu4XfsGi29HQm25jVqzyfcoAVt94osIFdG4Jj8i1ykjiTdkMc0sAUQttosT9d7348BNtDTI_LMzAYAAVQSAaA7t0VR8tZ2dLSQA2uJQWzrGyAfk_RjRmQZRYTdvd5dOIPliOCiFgcYeRgEL5JmA0u2Gw-Vro7HrBA62cIt2eLuB_AGLmV7TK3132kofQ?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. PayPal**

(Best for customer trust)

- Easy setup
- Recognizable checkout option
- Customers can pay with PayPal and supported card options
- Fees depend on checkout method

Best for: Adding another payment option to increase checkout convenience.

[PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/business)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Shopify Payments**

- Integrated directly into Shopify
- Simplifies orders, refunds and reporting
- Competitive processing rates
- Avoids additional third-party transaction fees

Best for: Stores already using Shopify.

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/payments)

---

![square-b0a05c48-2859-41e2-87cc-32b52f1944b4 | OpenFor.Co](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/vi4trsPTACbW1o92dnbpQw62l9r2gRnxnte9bpgWvyQWBVH55UH3pWGbSnp6L5Bp8phywOjWtDEQJQBz4QMH41M7SsbDiTLzMqDHHktT1h97ZgWMqUYhD9WdnRauMl9gTSwo0A5T6lcefZYiAYJbBm-kOP6jGj8emmWeREA9qkgkpjriOKMrS3A3yqkKLMxq?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Easy to use
- Online and in-person payments
- Inventory and point-of-sale tools
- Free entry-level options

Best for: Businesses selling online and at physical locations.

[Square website](https://squareup.com)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Helcim**

- Interchange-plus pricing
- No standard monthly subscription
- Potential savings as sales volume grows

Best for: Established small businesses looking to reduce processing costs.

[Helcim website](https://www.helcim.com)

Rates are indicative U.S. pricing; actual fees depend on payment type, plan and transaction details. [zapier.com](https://zapier.com/blog/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.itechguides.com](https://www.itechguides.com/best-online-payment-solutions-for-businesses-2026-buyers-guide/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[dupple.com](https://dupple.com/learn/best-payment-gateways?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

If I were starting a small online store today\:

- I'd choose Stripe as the primary processor.
- I'd offer PayPal as an additional checkout option.
- If using Shopify, I'd use Shopify Payments instead of Stripe directly.

That gives you flexibility without making payment processing unnecessarily complicated.
